Name: Nahath, Son of Zophai
Summary: Son of Zophai and father of Eliab in the Samuel line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:26: Son of Zophai and father of Eliab in the Samuel line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Nahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
